verses.original: בְּאֶחָד֩ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם יְהוָ֧ה וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’e·ḥāḏ haš·šê·nî la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nîṯ baš·šā·nāh lə·ṣê·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the first day of the second month of the second year after [the Israelites] had come out of the land of Egypt the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai He said

verses.original: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū ’eṯ- rōš kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: Take a census - - of the whole congregation . . . of Israel by their clans and families . . . listing every man by name one by one

verses.original: אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃ תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה צָבָ֖א כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn tip̄·qə·ḏū ’ō·ṯām ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh ṣā·ḇā kāl- yō·ṣê bə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age . . . or older by their divisions everyone who can serve in Israel’s army

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃ לְבֵית־ יִהְי֔וּ וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’îš lam·maṭ·ṭeh ’îš rōš ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw hū lə·ḇêṯ- yih·yū wə·’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: And one man . . . from each tribe - the head of each family . . . . . . must be there with you

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ya·‘am·ḏū ’it·tə·ḵem lir·’ū·ḇên ’ĕ·lî·ṣūr ben- šə·ḏê·’ūr
verses.literal: These are the names of the men who are to assist you From [the tribe of] Reuben Elizur son of Shedeur

verses.original: לְשִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šim·‘ō·wn šə·lu·mî·’êl ben- ṣū·rî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: from Simeon Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai

verses.original: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lî·hū·ḏāh naḥ·šō·wn ben- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: from Judah Nahshon son of Amminadab

verses.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār nə·ṯan·’êl ben- ṣū·‘ār
verses.literal: from Issachar Nethanel son of Zuar

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: liz·ḇū·lun ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ben- ḥê·lōn
verses.literal: from Zebulun Eliab son of Helon

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yō·w·sêp̄ lə·’ep̄·ra·yim ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ ben- ‘am·mî·hūḏ lim·naš·šeh gam·lî·’êl ben- pə·ḏā·h·ṣūr
verses.literal: from the sons of Joseph from Ephraim Elishama son of Ammihud and from Manasseh Gamaliel son of Pedahzur

verses.original: לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇin·yā·min ’ă·ḇî·ḏān ben- giḏ·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: from Benjamin Abidan son of Gideoni

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏān ’ă·ḥî·‘e·zer ben- ‘am·mî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: from Dan Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai

verses.original: לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ā·šêr paḡ·‘î·’êl ben- ‘ā·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: from Asher Pagiel son of Ocran

verses.original: לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡāḏ ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- də·‘ū·’êl
verses.literal: from Gad Eliasaph son of Deuel

verses.original: לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·nap̄·tā·lî ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: [and] from Naphtali Ahira son of Enan

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה קְרִיאֵי הָעֵדָ֔ה הֵֽם׃ נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh qə·rī·ʾē hā·‘ê·ḏāh hêm nə·śî·’ê maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām rā·šê ’al·p̄ê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: These men were appointed from the congregation they [were] the leaders of the tribes of their fathers the heads of the clans of Israel

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים וַיִּקַּ֥ח הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’êṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yiq·qaḥ hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer niq·qə·ḇū bə·šê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron - - took these men who had been designated by name

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת בְּאֶחָד֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הִקְהִ֗ילוּ כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֜ה וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃ שֵׁמ֗וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ bə·’e·ḥāḏ haš·šê·nî la·ḥō·ḏeš hiq·hî·lū kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yiṯ·yal·ḏū ‘al- miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ bə·mis·par lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām šê·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh
verses.literal: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families . . . counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age . . . or older

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm bə·miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: just as the LORD - had commanded Moses So [Moses] numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם שֵׁמוֹת֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên bə·ḵōr yiś·rā·’êl tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ bə·mis·par lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām šê·mō·wṯ kāl- zā·ḵār ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: - From the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age . . . or older - who could serve in the army

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh rə·’ū·ḇên šiš·šāh wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500 . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם שֵׁמוֹת֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê šim·‘ō·wn tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ pə·qu·ḏāw bə·mis·par lə·ḡul·gə·lō·ṯām šê·mō·wṯ kāl- zā·ḵār ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh kōl yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Simeon according to the records of their clans and families . . . vvv counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age . . . or older - who could serve in the army

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300 . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê ḡāḏ tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ kōl ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Gad according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting the names of all those twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army

verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.literal: From the sons of Judah according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting the names of all those twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army

verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600 . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת כֹּ֖ל עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê yiś·śā·š·ḵār tō·wl·ḏō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ bə·mis·par šê·mōṯ kōl ‘eś·rîm mib·ben šā·nāh wā·ma‘·lāh yō·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: From the sons of Issachar according to the records of their clans and families . . . counting the names of all those twenty years of age . . . or older who could serve in the army

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem lə·maṭ·ṭêh yiś·śā·š·ḵār ’ar·bā·‘āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400 . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם אֲבֹתָ֑ם לְבֵ֣ית בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת כֹּ֖ל עֶשְׂרִ֤ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְחָנ֖וּ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃ אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־ מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־ דִּגְל֖וֹ

verses.literal: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it so that no wrath will fall on the congregation vvv of Israel So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ צִוָּ֧ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

verses.literal: Thus the Israelites . . . did everything just as the LORD - had commanded Moses . . . . . .
